integrity: Exact universal proof included; standalone rational checker independently tests the matrix inverse and kernel row norms over 1982 reproducible cases, but finite computations do not prove universal statements or historical originality.
scientific_limitations: One affine element per arm, ordinary arc-length L2 orthogonality, m>=3, all edge lengths strictly positive. No extension to subdivided metric trees, weighted measures, or mass lumping. Equivalence in earlier literature cannot be ruled out, and independent mathematical/bibliographic audit has not been performed.
title: Exact shortest-arm law for continuous linear spline projection on metric stars
